From Kaffa, where coffee began

Coffee was born in the forests of Kaffa, in southwestern Ethiopia. We named our roastery after it — and we run the business the way farmers there have always worked: small lots, honest prices, nothing wasted.

We pay partner farms above the commodity price, roast in 12 kg batches so nothing sits in a warehouse, and stamp every bag with its roast date. If a bag is more than 30 days off roast, we take it off the shelf.
